This is for the LIghtTracker-W-2.0. This tracker has both WSPR and APRS. The goal is to see if it can send more data overland using WSPR.

- Original <https://github.com/lightaprs/LightAPRS-W-2.0>
- My fork <https://github.com/KF8EEZ/LightAPRS-W-2.0>
  - branch kf8eez-snickerdoodle has my changes
- Arduino Container <https://github.com/anielsen001/arduino-container/>
  - branch kf8eez-snickerdoodle has my changes


## APRS

- international frequency list here <http://www.phase-sa.com/ncyweb/APRSFREQ.html>

| 144.390 | North/South America freq   |
| 144.800 | Europe/South Africa/Russia |
| 145.175 | Australia                  |
| 144.175 | New Zealand                |
